prompt: Photorealistic three-quarter section product rendering of solar cold store in outdoor cooperative yard in bright daylight. Cut away front-left thick white polyurethane sandwich-panel walls and roof to reveal interior, keeping wall thickness visibly thick relative to door. Inside, two low side steel racks hold blue vented crates stacked three high with air gaps, filled with fresh vegetables, with centre aisle and raised slats. High inside rear wall show evaporator coil with small fan unit blowing cold air over crates. Outside to side in shade show compact steel chiller condenser box with fan grille piped through wall. Box sits anchored on low raised reinforced concrete plinth slab. Galvanized steel angle corner frame around box edges, and separate tilted PV panel rack with six dark monocrystalline panels standing apart behind box, with grey battery cabinet and copper cabling beside box. Single thick insulated door person-height at front, shown closed and sealed with gasket and handle, adult person standing beside for scale. Real materials: smooth white foam panels, galvanized metal, brushed concrete, blue food-grade plastic crates, green produce. Product-shot lighting, sharp focus, operating midday holding moment with fan running and produce fully loaded. Show thin leader-line callouts with plain names on small light tags in empty space for each focus part, clean and legible, and no other text.
must_not: hand sketch shading and wavy lines
changes_from_previous: First rendering - new section cutaway showing insulated box with full produce load and solar power chain.

visual_plan.view: Front three-quarter section view, slightly above eye level, side wall and part of roof removed to show interior while exterior PV, plinth, door and chiller remain readable.
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Raised concrete slab at bottom, 2m square box centered on it about taller than door, door on front face person-height, interior left and right racks with aisle in middle and crates three-high, fan high rear, chiller box outside right wall in shade, PV tilted rack and battery cabinet set apart behind left side, person beside door for scale.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Steady daytime holding at cold temperature with full one-tonne produce load present, door closed, evaporator fan circulating air, chiller running on solar with battery charging, cooperative daily use.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Sunlight onto PV array to battery cabinet via DC wiring to DC chiller to cold interior, with sensed box air looping to thermostat switching chiller, and fan driving uniform air over vented crates.
visual_plan.interactions: Box anchored to plinth, steel frame clamps panel corners, door hinged and gasket-sealed to box front, crates sit on side racks raised off floor with vent gaps, fan unit mounted high blows across evaporator over crates, chiller outside piped through wall to evaporator, PV rack separate from box wired to battery cabinet to chiller.
avoid: cutting through crates or hiding fan behind wall

focus_parts.purpose: Maintain cold insulated volume with low heat gain
Provide steady cooling to box interior
House washable produce load with vent gaps
Support full weight on washable raised base
Anchor panels and carry wind load
